ledger: Exterior diner & semi truck | night, dark blue sky, white cab idling with visible exhaust/steam, diner interior lit with red OPEN neon | early morning, pale sunrise sky, dark green cab parked in daylight, no exhaust | exhaust drifts and dissipates continuously, ambient light brightens gradually as dawn progresses

Diner interior lighting & environment | artificial overhead fluorescents, dark windows showing night outside | strong warm sunlight streaming through windows, long shadows across counter and booths | transition from night to sunrise is continuous and gradual, consistent with natural dawn

Waitress | light blue uniform with white apron, wiping counter with cloth | same uniform, seated at counter then standing and wiping again | wipes counter back-and-forth, pours coffee by tilting carafe, carries plate to patron, sits beside patron holding mug

Male patron / truck driver | not present, then enters from rear, approaches counter, brown jacket over plaid shirt | seated at counter with mug and plate, later places cash, stands and walks out toward truck | walks continuously to counter, sits on stool after reaching it, gestures while speaking, tilts mug to chest

Coffee carafe & mug | carafe full of dark liquid, empty white mug on counter | carafe tilted, stream of dark coffee flows into mug, mug then holds coffee with faint steam | pour starts only after carafe is inverted over mug, flow stops when carafe is uprighted

Plated meal (fried egg & toast) | not visible then steaming plate on counter | plate with sunny-side-up egg and toasted bread, steam rising | steam rises continuously from hot food, plate remains stationary once placed
